# Strathroy Heating & Cooling

> Strathroy Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Strathroy, Middlesex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (548) 708-7117  |  Email: contact@strathroyheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://strathroyheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Strathroy, London, St. Thomas, Dorchester, Komoka, Aylmer, Lucan
